provenance.source: Hand-authored synthetic RCA cases maintained in the DeployGuard AI repository; no production incidents or customer data are included.

candidates.cause: Retry policy amplified downstream payment failures.
candidates.next_step: Compare retry attempts with payment provider latency.

candidates.cause: Checkout workers saturated under elevated request volume.
candidates.next_step: Inspect worker saturation before and after the deployment.

candidates.cause: Fraud policy evaluation delayed payment authorization.
candidates.next_step: Compare fraud decision latency with the incident window.

candidates.cause: Catalog invalidation omitted affected product keys.
candidates.next_step: Replay invalidation keys against the affected catalog entries.

candidates.cause: Cache nodes evicted hot keys during memory pressure.
candidates.next_step: Inspect eviction counters for the incident window.

candidates.cause: Search indexing lag returned stale catalog documents.
candidates.next_step: Compare search index lag with stale response timestamps.

candidates.cause: Rotated signing keys were published after tokens began using them.
candidates.next_step: Compare token key IDs with the JWKS publication timeline.

candidates.cause: The verifier retained a stale JWKS document.
candidates.next_step: Inspect JWKS cache age and refresh outcomes.

candidates.cause: Gateway authorization middleware rejected otherwise valid tokens.
candidates.next_step: Compare gateway rejection reasons with direct verifier results.

candidates.cause: Connections were not returned after a timeout path.
candidates.next_step: Correlate open connections with timed-out transaction traces.

candidates.cause: Order workers exceeded their concurrency limit.
candidates.next_step: Compare worker concurrency with pool acquisition latency.

candidates.cause: Proxy pool limits rejected otherwise healthy connections.
candidates.next_step: Inspect proxy pool saturation and rejection counters.

candidates.cause: A retained checkout session object caused sustained heap growth.
candidates.next_step: Compare retained object types across consecutive heap snapshots.

candidates.cause: Payment retries retained request contexts and increased memory pressure.
candidates.next_step: Disable retries in a sandbox and compare allocation profiles.

candidates.cause: Session payload expansion increased checkout memory use.
candidates.next_step: Compare session payload size before and after the change.
